questions.question: FastAPI Cloud 部署要求哪些普通环境变量和秘密配置？
reference_points: 普通变量 PROJECT_NAME、FIRST_SUPERUSER、FRONTEND_HOST
secret SECRET_KEY、FIRST_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD、DATABASE_URL

evidence.quote:
* `PROJECT_NAME`: The name of the project, used in the API documentation and emails.
* `FIRST_SUPERUSER`: The email address of the first superuser.
* `FRONTEND_HOST`: The public URL of the application, such as the generated `https://your-app.fastapicloud.dev` URL or a custom domain.
evidence.section: FastAPI Project - Deployment / Configure the Application / Environment Variables

evidence.quote:
* `SECRET_KEY`: A secret key used to sign security tokens.
* `FIRST_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD`: The password of the first superuser.
* `DATABASE_URL`: The PostgreSQL connection URL, configured automatically when using a database integration.
evidence.section: FastAPI Project - Deployment / Configure the Application / Secrets

questions.question: 云部署工作流做什么？数据库有什么网络前提？

evidence.quote: The database must be reachable from GitHub-hosted runners so the preparation step can connect to it.
evidence.section: FastAPI Project - Deployment / Configure Continuous Deployment

evidence.quote:
1. Installs and builds the frontend into `backend/app/frontend`.
2. Runs `backend/scripts/prestart.sh` to apply database migrations and create the first superuser.
3. Deploys the project with `uv run fastapi deploy`.
evidence.section: FastAPI Project - Deployment / Configure Continuous Deployment

questions.question: 外部贡献者可以直接改依赖文件吗？想加依赖怎么办？

Note that PRs from non-team members are not allowed to modify `pyproject.toml` or `uv.lock`, to prevent supply chain risk.

evidence.quote: For **big changes** (new features, architectural changes, significant refactoring), please start by opening a [GitHub Discussion](https://github.com/fastapi/full-stack-fastapi-template/discussions) first.
evidence.section: Contributing / Discussions First

evidence.quote: For small, straightforward changes, you can go directly to a Pull Request without starting a discussion first.
evidence.section: Contributing / Discussions First

- Typos and grammatical fixes

evidence.section: Contributing / Discussions First

questions.question: 修改功能后提交 PR，有哪些检查和说明要求？
reference_points: 测试通过

功能改变更新测试

evidence.quote:
1. Make sure all tests pass before submitting.
2. Keep PRs focused on a single change.
3. Update tests if you're changing functionality.
